@@ -0,0 +1,79 @@
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat.mock import Mock, call, patch
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux import LinuxNetwork, LinuxNetworkCollector
+
+
+def test_get_locally_reachable_ips():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, '\n'.join([
+            'local 192.168.1.24/24 dev lo scope host',
+            'local 127.0.0.1/32 dev lo scope host',
+            'local 127.0.0.0/8 dev lo scope host',
+            'local 192.168.0.1 dev lo scope host',
+            'local 192.168.1.0/24 dev lo scope host',
+            'broadcast 192.168.1.255 dev eth0 scope link',
+            'local invalid dev lo scope host',
+        ]), ''),
+        (0, '\n'.join([
+            'local 2001:db8::5/64 dev lo',
+            'local ::1/128 dev lo',
+            'local 2001:db8::/64 dev lo',
+            'local 2001:db8::1 dev lo',
+        ]), ''),
+    ]
+
+    with patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', True):
+        result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip')
+
+    assert result == {
+        'ipv4': ['127.0.0.0/8', '127.0.0.1', '192.168.0.1', '192.168.1.0/24'],
+        'ipv6': ['::1', '2001:db8::/64', '2001:db8::1'],
+    }
+    assert module.run_command.call_args_list == [
+        call(['/sbin/ip', '-4', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'local', 'scope', 'host'], errors='surrogate_then_replace'),
+        call(['/sbin/ip', '-6', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'local', 'scope', 'host'], errors='surrogate_then_replace'),
+    ]
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Ignored invalid locally reachable ipv4 route')
+
+
+def test_get_locally_reachable_ips_query_failure():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [(0, 'local 127.0.0.1 dev lo', ''), (1, '', 'unsupported')]
+
+    with patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', True):
+        result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip')
+
+    assert result == {'ipv4': ['127.0.0.1'], 'ipv6': []}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Unable to gather locally reachable ipv6 routes')
+
+
+def test_populate_exposes_locally_reachable_ips():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/ip'
+    network = LinuxNetwork(module)
+    network.get_default_interfaces = Mock(return_value=({}, {}))
+    network.get_interfaces_info = Mock(return_value=({}, {'all_ipv4_addresses': [], 'all_ipv6_addresses': []}))
+    network.get_locally_reachable_ips = Mock(return_value={'ipv4': ['127.0.0.0/8'], 'ipv6': ['::1']})
+
+    facts = network.populate()
+
+    assert facts['locally_reachable_ips'] == {'ipv4': ['127.0.0.0/8'], 'ipv6': ['::1']}
+    network.get_locally_reachable_ips.assert_called_once_with('/sbin/ip')
+
+
+def test_populate_without_ip_command():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = None
+
+    facts = LinuxNetwork(module).populate()
+
+    assert facts['locally_reachable_ips'] == {'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': []}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Unable to gather locally reachable IPs: ip command not found')
+
+
+def test_locally_reachable_ips_is_a_network_fact_id():
+    assert 'locally_reachable_ips' in LinuxNetworkCollector._fact_ids
